description: Practice mode, Consumer Pulse copy only: use a memo handed off under your handoff_code (ref 'latest') for a purpose. Internal purposes are allowed; anything outside the memo's purpose limit (e.g. publish externally) is refused and recorded. Wrong codes are rate-limited (HANDOFF_GUESS_LOCKED).

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of your practice copy (returned by atlas.enter_demo). Optional when you have one copy.

purpose.description: Why you want this, in your own words.

session_id.description: Optional session id, if the client supplies one.
